CREATE TABLE doc.search_title (
  id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
  tmdb_id BIGINT,
  media_type TEXT,
  title TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  original_title TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  release_year INTEGER,
  release_decade INTEGER,
  adult BOOLEAN,
  genres ARRAY(TEXT),
  production_method TEXT,
  is_anime BOOLEAN, suitability_adults BOOLEAN, suitability_date_night BOOLEAN, suitability_family BOOLEAN, suitability_friends BOOLEAN, suitability_group_party BOOLEAN, suitability_intergenerational BOOLEAN, suitability_kids BOOLEAN, suitability_partner BOOLEAN, suitability_public_viewing_safe BOOLEAN, suitability_solo_watch BOOLEAN, suitability_teens BOOLEAN, context_is_background_friendly BOOLEAN, context_is_binge_friendly BOOLEAN, context_is_comfort_watch BOOLEAN, context_is_drop_in_friendly BOOLEAN, context_is_pure_escapism BOOLEAN, context_is_thought_provoking BOOLEAN,
  tags TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  keywords TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  tropes TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  essence_text TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  creators TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  cast_names TEXT INDEX USING FULLTEXT WITH (analyzer = 'english'),
  tags_list ARRAY(TEXT), keywords_list ARRAY(TEXT), tropes_list ARRAY(TEXT), creators_list ARRAY(TEXT), cast_names_list ARRAY(TEXT),
  votes BIGINT,
  goodwatch_score REAL,
  popularity REAL,
  fingerprint_scores OBJECT(STRICT) AS (adrenaline SMALLINT, tension SMALLINT, scare SMALLINT, violence SMALLINT, romance SMALLINT, eroticism SMALLINT, wholesome SMALLINT, wonder SMALLINT, pathos SMALLINT, melancholy SMALLINT, uncanny SMALLINT, catharsis SMALLINT, nostalgia SMALLINT, situational_comedy SMALLINT, wit_wordplay SMALLINT, physical_comedy SMALLINT, cringe_humor SMALLINT, absurdist_humor SMALLINT, satire_parody SMALLINT, dark_humor SMALLINT, fantasy SMALLINT, futuristic SMALLINT, historical SMALLINT, contemporary_realism SMALLINT, crime SMALLINT, mystery SMALLINT, warfare SMALLINT, political SMALLINT, sports SMALLINT, biographical SMALLINT, coming_of_age SMALLINT, family_dynamics SMALLINT, psychological SMALLINT, showbiz SMALLINT, gaming SMALLINT, pop_culture SMALLINT, social_commentary SMALLINT, class_and_capitalism SMALLINT, technology_and_humanity SMALLINT, spiritual SMALLINT, narrative_structure SMALLINT, dialogue_quality SMALLINT, character_depth SMALLINT, slow_burn SMALLINT, fast_pace SMALLINT, intrigue SMALLINT, complexity SMALLINT, rewatchability SMALLINT, hopefulness SMALLINT, bleakness SMALLINT, ambiguity SMALLINT, novelty SMALLINT, homage_and_reference SMALLINT, non_linear_narrative SMALLINT, meta_narrative SMALLINT, surrealism SMALLINT, eccentricity SMALLINT, philosophical SMALLINT, educational SMALLINT, direction SMALLINT, acting SMALLINT, cinematography SMALLINT, editing SMALLINT, music_composition SMALLINT, world_immersion SMALLINT, spectacle SMALLINT, visual_stylization SMALLINT, pastiche SMALLINT, psychedelic SMALLINT, grotesque SMALLINT, camp_and_irony SMALLINT, dialogue_centrality SMALLINT, music_centrality SMALLINT, sound_centrality SMALLINT),
  fps ARRAY(SMALLINT)
) WITH (number_of_replicas = 0, refresh_interval = 1000)

crate.bm25_stmt: SELECT id, _score FROM doc.search_title WHERE MATCH((tags 2, keywords 2, tropes 1, essence_text 1), ?) USING most_fields AND votes >= 2000 ORDER BY _score DESC LIMIT 300
crate.fetch_stmt: SELECT id, votes, goodwatch_score, popularity, release_year, fps FROM doc.search_title WHERE id = ANY(?)
